title: 第7章 原来是你第8章 我拒绝
lines: 烈日当空，极其炎热。
湮鼎宗。
“林铮，你自己去登记，清漪随我去见宗主。”
洛清漪有些不舍，握着林铮的手，小声道：“林大哥等我，我一定帮你。”
极其不情愿，洛清漪跟着韩飞离去。
巨大广场。
陈老坐着，登记着新来的弟子。
“陈老，这是我的身份令牌。”
“林铮？”
陈老抬起头，看着面前突然出现的青年，狠狠瞪了一眼，不悦道：“数百新弟子，人人都恨不得立刻入宗，唯独你姗姗来迟，要不是因为等你，老夫也不用在烈日下暴晒。”
心里很是感激，因为这位陈老对他一直不错，林铮从空间戒指内取出一壶酒，放在石桌上。
“陈老，这是三焱城一家小酒馆的女儿红，味道不错，你尝尝。”
眼神顿时一亮，陈老嗜酒如命，立刻拿起酒壶，打开壶盖，咕噜噜喝了几口。
“老夫最喜欢喝这种小酒馆的酒，够烈够香。”
“算你小子有心。”
取过身份令牌，在上面注入信息，还给林铮说道：“身份令牌内，我已经灌入宗门的所有信息，还有你的住处，给你小子安排了一处不错的洞府，用身份令牌就可以进入。”
接过身份令牌，林铮行礼，说道：“多谢陈老，那我就去了。”
“去吧。”
元神涌入身份令牌，大概了解了一下湮鼎宗，还有自己的住处。
广场左侧，山峰半腰。
湮鼎宗对待弟子很是不错，无论天赋如何，只要能成为宗门弟子，都会分配到独立洞府。
武者修炼，最是忌讳被打扰。
“咦？我是不是眼花了。”
“林师弟怎么了？”
林龙使劲的揉了揉双眼，自从进入湮鼎宗，他就是拼命的修炼，提升了一个阶位，还不知道弟弟被杀的消息。
“我看到了一个不应该出现在这里的人。”
还以为是自己见了鬼，当初要不是因为天梯有规则，不能出现死亡，他肯定不会放过林铮。
还真是放虎归山。
“林铮，站住！”
停下脚步慢慢转过身，看着朝自己走来的林龙，林铮笑了，他想要来湮鼎宗，主要目的就是为了林龙两人。
“原来真是你。”
“林龙师弟，他是谁？”
“我来给你介绍，这是我的堂哥林铮，之前参加天梯考核，不小心气海碎裂，境界跌落。”
“那他是怎么来到宗门的。”
林龙笑了笑，看着林铮问道：“我的好堂哥，你是否能告诉我，你是怎么站在这里的。”
“为了杀你。”
“就凭你一个气海破碎的废物？”
懒得再多说，按照身份令牌内的宗门规则，不容许私底下残杀同门弟子，一旦被发现，轻者废掉修为逐出宗门，重者直接格杀勿论。
等找到机会再说。
content_en:
The sun was blazing in the sky and it was extremely hot.
The Yin Ding Sect.
"Lin Zheng, go and register yourself. Qingyi will follow me to see the sect leader."
Luo Qingyi was a little reluctant, holding Lin Zheng's hand and whispered: "Brother Lin, wait for me, I will definitely help you."
"Yeah."
Extremely reluctant, Luo Qingyi followed Han Fei and left.
Huge square.
Mr. Chen was sitting, registering the new disciples.
"Mr. Chen, this is my identity token."
"Lin Zheng?"
Mr. Chen raised his head, looked at the young man who suddenly appeared in front of him, glared hard, and said displeasedly: "Hundreds of new disciples, everyone is eager to join the sect immediately, but you are the only one who came late. If it weren't for waiting for you, I wouldn't have to be exposed to the scorching sun."
Feeling very grateful because Mr. Chen had always been kind to him, Lin Zheng took out a bottle of wine from the space ring and placed it on the stone table.
"Mr. Chen, this is Nuerhong from a tavern in Sanyan City. It tastes good. Try it."
His eyes suddenly lit up. Mr. Chen was addicted to alcohol. He immediately picked up the wine pot, opened the lid, and took a few sips.
"I like to drink the wine from this tavern the most. It's strong and fragrant."
"I guess you have a heart."
He took the identity token, injected information on it, and said to Lin Zheng: "In the identity token, I have filled in all the information about the sect, as well as your residence, and arranged a good cave for you. You can enter with the identity token."
After receiving the identity token, Lin Zheng saluted and said, "Thank you, Mr. Chen, I'll go then."
"Go ahead."
Yuanshen poured into the identity token and got a rough idea of the Diding Sect and his own residence.
On the left side of the square, halfway up the mountain.
The Yanding Sect treats its disciples very well. No matter how talented they are, as long as they can become a disciple of the sect, they will be assigned to an independent cave.
When a warrior is practicing, he is most afraid of being disturbed.
"Eh? Am I dazzled?"
"What's wrong with Junior Brother Lin?"
Lin Long rubbed his eyes vigorously. Ever since he entered the Dioding Sect, he had been practicing hard and rising to a higher level. He still didn't know about the death of his younger brother.
"I saw someone who shouldn't be here."
He thought he had seen a ghost. If it weren't for the rules of the ladder, which prohibited death, he would definitely not have let Lin Zheng go.
It’s really letting the tiger return to the mountain.
"Lin Zheng, stop!"
Stopping and turning around slowly, Lin Zheng smiled as he looked at Lin Long walking towards him. The main reason he wanted to come to Annihilation Sect was for Lin Long and the two of them.
"It turns out it's really you."
"Junior Brother Lin Long, who is he?"
"Let me introduce to you. This is my cousin Lin Zheng. He participated in the ladder assessment before, but accidentally the sea of ​​qi shattered and his realm fell."
"Then how did he come to the sect."
Lin Long smiled, looked at Lin Zheng and asked, "My good cousin, can you tell me how you are standing here."
"To kill you."
"You're just a piece of trash with a broken Qihai sea?"
I don’t want to say more, but according to the sect rules in the identity token, killing fellow disciples in private is not allowed. Once discovered, the person who is in the least case will have their cultivation level revoked and be expelled from the sect, and the person who is in the most serious case will be killed without mercy.
Wait until you find the opportunity.
title_en: Chapter 7 It turns out to be you Chapter 8 I refuse
